# OrchString

> orchstring is an AI-powered, enterprise-oriented execution platform designed to transform business objectives into coordinated, controlled, and verifiable workflows.

orchstring develops an enterprise execution platform.

## Official website

https://orchstring.com/

## OrchString

orchstring is an intelligent execution platform designed to turn goals into controlled, observable and verifiable work across agents, models, tools, applications and operating systems.

Core concepts include:
- Goal-driven agent execution
- Multi-task orchestration and dependency graphs
- Planning and deterministic execution
- Agent placement and worker lifecycle
- Model and provider abstraction
- Capability and tool discovery
- Authorization, policy and security boundaries
- Observation, critique, reasoning and verification
- Execution attempts, leases and fencing
- Checkpoints, recovery and replanning
- Developer intelligence
- OS-agnostic execution with future native OS integration

## Architecture

orchstring separates intelligence from any single model, application or operating system. Its target lifecycle is:

Understand → Decompose → Plan → Discover → Select → Authorize → Execute → Observe → Critique → Reason → Verify → Recover / Replan → Learn
